native_codex_plugin.scope: User-level Codex plugin registration; not restricted to this subproject

project_local_skills.method: Copied upstream skill snapshot at the recorded commit
project_local_skills.reproduction_note: A fresh checkout must restore the upstream skill snapshot; these ignored files are not included in Git. Copying a skill does not install every optional dependency or verify that capability.

dependency_installation.result: Dependencies downloaded successfully from official PyPI and installed into the project .venv with low download concurrency
dependency_installation.network_notes: Index pages were reachable. Official PyPI Windows wheel transfers were faster than the tested domestic mirrors. Universal dependency resolution also requested unrelated macOS wheels and encountered timeouts.
dependency_installation.snapshot_prerequisite: Playwright Chromium must also be installed; installing the Python snapshot extra alone does not download the browser.

runtime_workaround.observed_failure: Initial OpenBLAS import with default threading exhausted available memory and failed
runtime_workaround.result: CAD model generation, saved STEP checks and engineering drawing generation succeeded with single-thread numerical library settings
runtime_workaround.scope: The script saves and restores process environment values; it does not persist these values to user or machine settings

saved_step_geometry.measurement_basis: Saved STEP B-rep readback against independent specifications; not merely source constants

engineering_drawing.visual_qa_evidence: Root agent rendered and visually reviewed the generated PDF during this task

cli_viewer.browser_evidence: Codex in-app browser displayed all six STEP models from the local CLI viewer; source geometry remained local
cli_viewer.scope: Local loopback CLI viewer, separate from the native Codex CAD tab

keepalive.method: Root agent retained a Wait-Process exec session so its background viewer was not killed when exec exited
keepalive.note: Task-specific process lifetime evidence; this is not persistent installation configuration

native_codex_viewer.status: Native plugin installed and launch requested; no actual native viewer display verified
native_codex_viewer.evidence: Root agent observed cad_open launch output followed by cad_view returning views=[]

chromium_snapshots.browser_cache_scope: User-level Playwright browser cache, shared by Playwright projects
chromium_snapshots.note: All six saved STEP snapshots were generated and independently viewed; run-demo.ps1 completed with exit code 0.
